name: An Naafi’
description: Allah grants benefit and good; no one can prevent the good He wills to give.
summary: An Naafi' expresses Allah's granting of benefit and good. Quran 10:107 states that no one can repel the good He intends, while 6:17 places harm and good under His power. It is considered alongside Ad Daarr, rather than as a competing source of power.
